data.title: The Thrifty Merchant
data.statement:
A merchant uses a simple cash register. Each day, he records the amount of every sale on a list. At the end of the day, he wants to know how many sales were required to reach (or exceed) a revenue target, processing the sales in the order they occurred.

Write a program that reads a target N and a list of sales amounts, then displays the index (starting from 1) of the sale at which the cumulative total reaches or exceeds N.

If the target is never reached even after summing all sales, display IMPOSSIBLE.
data.constraints:
1 ≤ N ≤ 10,000
1 ≤ M ≤ 1,000
1 ≤ amount of each sale ≤ 1,000

data.inputDescription:
Line 1: two integers N and M separated by a space
N: the revenue target
M: the number of sales for the day
Line 2: M integers separated by spaces, representing the sale amounts in chronological order
data.outputDescription:
An integer: the rank (1-indexed) of the sale that causes the target to be reached
Or IMPOSSIBLE if the target is never reached

lastVersion.statementHTML:
Goal

A merchant uses a simple cash register. Each day, he records the amount of every sale on a list. At the end of the day, he wants to know how many sales were required to reach (or exceed) a revenue target, processing the sales in the order they occurred.

Write a program that reads a target N and a list of sales amounts, then displays the index (starting from 1) of the sale at which the cumulative total reaches or exceeds N.

If the target is never reached even after summing all sales, display IMPOSSIBLE.
Input
Line 1: two integers N and M separated by a space
N: the revenue target
M: the number of sales for the day
Line 2: M integers separated by spaces, representing the sale amounts in chronological order
Output
An integer: the rank (1-indexed) of the sale that causes the target to be reached
Or IMPOSSIBLE if the target is never reached
Constraints
1 ≤ N ≤ 10,000
1 ≤ M ≤ 1,000
1 ≤ amount of each sale ≤ 1,000
Example
Input
100 5
20 30 10 50 15
Output
4
